text: 0.18.101 hot-seat merge lesson: when display-help extraction has moved queue ai/help text into resources, merge later AI/help patches into resources.d/display rather than reintroducing queuebash heredocs.
0.18.101 installer lesson: system install must install resources.d display/help payloads into the share tree and include those installed resource targets in signing/verification tests.

0.18.101 merge lesson: mixed patchset wrappers differ; Bob18 apply supports --check but not --json, while Bob19 is nested under patchset101, so use merge-plan plus manifest/file inspection instead of assuming one apply interface.
